name: Soika
description: Soika was a terrestrial planet which was the homeworld of the Soikan species. It was located in the Soika system in the Inner Rim Territories, in grid square M-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. By the High Republic Era, Soika had been ravaged by the Soikan conflict, a war between several factions of Soikans.
